data.content_ref: inline:The reduction relation is asserted as "SRC_001 reduces to SRC_005," yet the supplied refutation-if condition is a stronger invariant (name-explicitness) that the proffered reduction does not actually preserve. A reduction that silently drops a required observable is unsound, so the relation as stated is not a valid reduction under the standard — it is a candidate reduction whose counterexample is embedded in its own refutation-if. The target does not resolve or acknowledge this tension; it leaves the relation in a self-defeating state where the reduction is refuted by the very endpoint it claims to reduce to.
